recipes.name: Dale's Summertime Salmon
ingredients_raw: 1 (6 ounce) can pineapple chunks with juice
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Place the salmon fillet in a baking dish; top with the pineapple with juice, kale, onions, and capers. Drizzle the olive oil and lemon juice over the salmon. Season with the salt and black pepper. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until the salmon flakes easily with a fork, about 25 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Dale's Summertime Salmon
raw_recipe.description: The lemon, capers, and pineapple in this recipe perfectly complement the flaky salmon to help create a great spring or summer meal.

review.reviewBody: This is a great dish, that I made some modifications to. First, I combined the juice from the pineapple with a bit of soy sauce and 1/2 lemon juice and marinated the salmon in it. I then removed the salmon and patted it dry and seared the skin side in a hot pan for 3 minutes, then flipped for 2 minutes until slightly browned. I put the salmon in a baking dish and poured the marinade over, and threw in pineapple chunks, capers, onion, remaining half lemon juice and olive oil. Sprinkled with pepper, covered with foil (with holes) and let bake until flaky. I would have included kale if I had any.

A nice healthy and tasty meal! I loved any kind of fruit with Salmon, and this recipe is just my style! I used spinach instead of the kale and omitted the capers. I sauteed the onions and spinach for 5 minutes in a pan to make sure they were well cooked with the salmon. Juicy and tasty! Will make again.

Simply Delicious! The great things about Allrecipes recipes are the unique flavor combinations that home cooks create. This salmon dish is one of those. I would not have put the flavor combination of salmon, pineapple, kale and onion together in my imagination. Well, silly me. It was wonderful, and full of different textures with the soft and fruity pineapple chunks, the curliness of the kale, the crunchy onion slices that wrapped around the salmon, and the little capers to top off the layers of yumminess. I juiced one whole lemon. The salmon cooked nicely at 25 minutes but next time I will cook it at 20 minutes for a slightly more succulent finish. I paired this entrée with champagne it was a beautiful light summer dinner!

I've never had pineapple with salmon before, but it paired well and I really enjoyed it. The recipe is easy to put together once you have all the ingredients. I ended up zesting my lemon and adding that along with the lemon juice which added a fresh brightness. I think you could easily double or triple the kale to have more of a built-in veggie side dish. A fun fresh sweet and tangy dish! It's good both hot out of the oven and served cold as leftovers.

This salmon dish is really good. It was so flaky and moist. It had great flavor. I do feel that it could use a little more pineapple flavor, next time I will use pineapple rings directly on the salmon. Otherwise, I wouldn't change a thing. It's a perfect healthy dish.

Delicious and nutritious and so easy! I pretty much followed the recipe exactly. I used crushed pineapple. I used fresh frozen kale that was already chopped, probably closer to 2 cups. Added extra capers and a little caper juice. Served over brown rice to which I added lemon and capers. I had white onion and loved that they were slightly al dente. Red onion would be good too. Will definitely make again!

I made this recipe last night, we had all ingredients on hand EXCEPT the pineapple. I usually attempt every recipe first as written....however this was my first exception. It was FABULOUS!!! My family scarfed it up, even my picky 2 year old I used 1.5 lb Salmon, I will definitely be making this again with the pineapple, just to try it!!

This recipe is delicious. I added extra veggies like broccoli, mushrooms and carrots on top of the salmon as well as took tips from other posters and marinated the fish ahead of time. It turned out great and my husband also loved it!

My husband and I really enjoyed this dish. I followed another reviewer's advise and marinated, then seared the fish before baking it. I used fresh pineapple and some organic juice instead of the can. Perfect meal for a summer evening!
Delicious! The pineapple gives it a light taste.
